findings.message: Commit bump in upstream-sourced trigger requires recipe comparison. Per §3, a source bump demands fetching the prior and proposed rockcraft.yaml to verify no parts: or services: entries were dropped (recipe regression), confirm deb-security-manifest compliance for any stage-packages, and confirm package source provenance. Both snapshots are missing from this offline review bundle; recipe gates cannot pass.

summary: Single commit bump in canonical/demo-rock from 0000000000000000000000000000000000000018 to 0000000000000000000000000000000000000019 on the stable 1.2-24.04 track at edge risk. Recipe snapshots unavailable for offline review; recipe-regression and deb-manifest gates cannot be assessed. Track naming, EOL declaration, and release structure are sound. Support plan confirmation needed for upstream-sourced EOL cap validation.
